notes.title: Sailist Early Access - Update 1.2 (Place Furniture)

[/p][h2]Buy Furniture[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/3d8c63e0547aa1c32e45a526fd19c814158df634.png"][/img]Over 50 pieces of furniture have been added, and they can be purchased from the newly added furniture vendor NPC in town. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the list of ships owned in the Port Manager menu to show each ship’s modified name.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Sailist Early Access - Update 1.1.4 (Sail Rotation)
notes.content:
[h3]Sail Rotation Feature[/h3]
Sailors now rotate the sails according to the direction of the wind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/e839eaafe615e5883f05fd5960ccc0d4bcfdffdd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/c780807a5a8b3715e6f2fa2011b205fe250f23ba.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/59673a5d9de9d0770af2687fc8cbe5be7cd3303a.png[/img]

This update has been applied to all ships in Sailist, and ship speed now responds more realistically based on wind direction and sail orientation.
The number of sailors assigned to sail duties and their morale affect the speed at which the sails rotate.

Player-controlled ships can now turn at maximum rotational acceleration regardless of sailor morale.
However, AI-controlled player ships will still be affected by morale when turning.

I hope this update enhances the joy of sailing with the wind and encourages more strategic route planning based on wind conditions!


[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Feature:[/b] Sail Rotation.
[*] Adjusted all ship models and added dynamic ropes to support the sail rotation.
[*] Added the feature to manually fire individual cannons.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where cannons were reloaded when changing non-cannon ship equipment
[*] Fixed a bug where trade goods displayed price ratios lower than -100%
[*] Revised the description of sail ship equipment to be more descriptive
[/list]

notes.title: Sailist Early Access - Update 1.1.2 (New Galley Ship)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/85c51b4b2b9e2d938234424344612f88df1e0493.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/4b18b760b21eea5c082982dd487c6bae11437539.gif[/img]

Galley Type.A boasts excellent maneuverability but requires a large crew for operation. Equipped with a flamethrower at the bow, it is specialized for ramming tactics in combat.

I hope this ship will be a great choice for players who enjoy galleys and allow for more diverse combat styles!

[*] Increased the player village decoration limit (50 → 80).

[*] Improved the quality of some translations.
[/list]

notes.title: Sailist Early Access - Update 1.1 (Village Construction)
notes.content:
[h1]Village Construction[/h1]
[b]Players can now build villages on designated sites to produce trade goods directly![/b]


[h2]Discover Village Sites[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/af2b4bdbdeb411e44eeae64917afffcce79692c2.png[/img]
While sailing, you can observe the terrain to discover vacant coastal areas where villages can be built.


[h2]Construct a Port[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/63b2fce5803f799317361cc09a977c41d437e3d0.gif[/img]
When a character enters a vacant site, you can pay a fee to construct a port. At this port, Supplies can be purchased without limitations.


[h2]Manage Village List[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/25668a5216872570864cfd8b337728421d5f03ba.png[/img]
Once a port is built, the village will be added to the [b]My Village[/b] list in the main menu. If all ships are docked at the port and not carrying trade goods, [b]you can instantly move to the village.
[/b]



[h1]Village Management[/h1]

[h2]Building Construction[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/764dce65141b7e35e58bb1b92a9b1e6dff5da55d.png[/img]
Building construction primarily requires trade goods from the [b]Building Materials[/b] category.


[h2]Expand Population[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/b7aad075ce69bc948fa908c5f298c177380743f4.png[/img]
Build houses to secure the villagers needed for production buildings.


[h2]Storage[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/48894db5ddf4a6e2e98137de0fac9f362849605f.png[/img]
Before constructing production buildings, make sure to build storage facilities to store the produced trade goods. Without proper storage, production will halt!


[h2]Production[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/764dce65141b7e35e58bb1b92a9b1e6dff5da55d.png[/img]
Each production building can produce specific trade goods, and you can select one item to produce. Some trade goods require materials from other production buildings to be actively produced.
Production efficiency varies greatly depending on the biome where your village is located. Strategically choose your production based on the surrounding environment!


[h2]Building Management[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/9813ed964bca19108408264919fdebb4423fb087.png[/img]
You can approach a building and use the interaction key to open the building management menu to utilize its functions.


[h2]Decoration[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/8e208ab5a6abaf0b66a776cc71d75481d576c3df.png[/img]
Use decorative items to beautify your village and make it truly unique. Add charm and create a village that's distinctively yours!


I hope you strategically utilize your villages to efficiently dominate the vast oceans!
Thank you for waiting for this update, and I look forward to introducing additional features for player villages in future updates!



[h2]Others[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Zoom range has been expanded.
[*] Mouse buttons can now be assigned to key bindings.
[*] Production speeds for trade goods have been adjusted.
[*] Interaction distance for NPCs and the helm has been increased.
[*] Holding the Control or Shift key while pressing the quantity adjustment buttons now increases or decreases by 100 and 10.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs that could cause memory leaks
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when playing for very long periods of time.
[/list]

notes.title: Sailist Early Access - Update 1.0.6 (New Ship)
notes.content:
[h3]New Ship[/h3]
In this update, I’ve added another new ship: the Light Galleon Type.A!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/33c6d8abfb1793c0f0f82ead50f79d1021734ea4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/b45c05bfc8ec61c83ac4a15f495813686d79f618.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/eac0c7eb0cbbe7409143eb6a5bd89c25b6d8c0f0.png[/img]

The Light Galleon Type.A is a lightweight, medium-sized ship with excellent maneuverability, available for purchase in the early to mid-game. Players will be able to choose between this ship and the Galleon Type.A depending on their playstyle.

I hope that when players purchase their first medium-sized ship, this will add to the enjoyment of making a choice, and that they will have a pleasant sailing experience with this agile ship!


[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Ship: Adding the Light Galleon Type.A.
[*] Light Galleon Type.A spawn as NPC trade ships and pirate ships.
[*] The ropes attached to the sail have been improved to be visible only when the sail is unfurled.
[*] The defense ships in a Pirate Fortress are spawned with a ship class equal to or greater than that of a Light Galleon.
[*] Adjusted the types of ships sold in the ship shop to make it easier for players to purchase early ships in the starting area village.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where body art could have different colors after character creation
[*] Some Japanese translation corrections.
[/list]

notes.title: Sailist Early Access - Update 1.0.5 (New Ship)

[h3]New Ship[/h3]
In this update, I added a new ship, the Sloop Type.A!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/d13da350f99265320b420477430c60e02cdf60b0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/e30f35718622c40d401101f8365b1bae22dc70f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/70af67c33101fed9528344be913dea970347fc31.png[/img]

The Sloop Type.A is a small ship that can be easily purchased early in the game, but can perform well in combat thanks to its moderate maneuverability and eight cannons, four on each side.
I hope to be able to easily destroy small ship pirates early in the game with this ship, and I look forward to challenging battles against this small but fairly powerful ship.


[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Ship: Adding the Sloop Type.A
[*] You can now see Sloop Type A, which is a pirate ship.
[*] Changed ship shops in medium-sized villages to sell two types of small ships.
(It is possible that a medium-sized village has only one type of small ship for sale in its Ship Shop, and this update may have changed the types of small ships sold in each village's Ship Shop.)
[*] Improved cannon reloading animations for the Herring buss and the Schooner.
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog #3: Current roadmap
notes.content:
[h2]Overview[/h2]
First, I would like to sincerely thank everyone who has shown interest in the game, purchased it, and provided feedback. In this log, I would like to introduce the content that I am currently prioritizing. Of course, this is not the end of the planned content updates. Future content will be organized and introduced once the planned content is sufficiently completed. Additionally, I promise continuous improvement updates and ask for your understanding that plans may change based on development progress and feedback.



[h2]New Ships[/h2]
Currently, there are 10 types of ships in the world of Sailist, but I believe there is a lack of ships available in the early stages of the game. Therefore, I plan to add more ships that can be purchased in the early game to address this issue.


[h3]Sloop[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/7be30805fff2fb586b25edef5ed8dcab444f4daa.png[/img]
The sloop, which can be purchased in the early game, will be equipped with a total of 8 cannons, 4 on each side. With the strongest armament among small ships, this ship is expected to make it easier to sink small pirate ships in the early stages of the game.


[h3]Light Galleon[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/acb86ed57b1ddd439f249e183e7561da152a0737.png[/img]
The light galleon, with its fast and agile speed, will compete with the Galleon Type.A, offering ample storage and decent armament. This ship aims to broaden the choices available when upgrading to a galleon.



[h2]Village Construction[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/50a3c6966513c31f9b9007caa9a5eacb4f435dab.gif[/img]
(This is a concept rendering.)

Currently, trade goods are only important in terms of their category for quest completion or village events. Additionally, if you're unlucky, you might have to bring trade goods from very distant villages due to the unavailability of certain categories of trade goods in nearby villages. To address this, I plan to add village construction content, allowing players to build their own villages. Players will need specific trade goods (such as wood for building houses) to construct villages, and building production facilities will enable the production of specific trade goods. Additionally, I am planning a ship upgrade system in the shipyard facility to enhance the performance of ships. 
I hope this content increases the game's potential for expansion and allows players to become more immersed in the world of Sailist.



[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
Thank you always for your interest and support for Sailist. I will do my best to continue improving the game.

Thank you!

notes.title: Devlog #2: Ship of the line
notes.content:
[h2]Progress updates[/h2]
Hello Sailist captains!
In the meantime, Sailist has been a constant work in progress, and most of the things I mentioned in my devlog1 have been added. 
However, I still think it will take some time for it to be fully matured.



[h2]Ship of the line[/h2]
In this devlog, I'm revealing the biggest, most magnificent ship in the game: the Ship of the line!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/76010d02607922863c24805909a2c76f92cc53cd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/967700ccfe205668ddd2a43004169215a5be2009.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/8dd7c6dd84dfd0a4dacc1a1391c5d28af02d188e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/a96692a7cf6f0bb56688abea6ba6c41fde77cae6.png[/img]
The ship has a total of 74 cannons, with two bow and two stern cannons. True to its name, the Fortress of the Sea has low maneuverability, but is very strong and stable in heavy seas.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/d0d07950f9f2e47226c6163597befb3ea90e9316.png[/img]
With this ship, you'll be able to calm the seas of Sailist!



Thanks as always for your interest and excitement, and I hope to see you in the next update!

notes.title: Sailist Demo - Update 1.3: Sailors Shooting Muskets
notes.content:
[h2]Sailors Shooting Muskets[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/7be5f0d508ae74c820a6301e5123820f1d772403.gif[/img]
You can place sailors that shoot muskets. When you place more battle crew members than there are cannons available, a crew member is placed to fire the muskets.

[h2]Looting Empty Ships[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/d50e8d24498edb83eb8c4c4b854714f3bc499dcd.gif[/img]
When you approach a ship with all of its sailors removed, you can loot the ship's cargo without loss.

notes.title: Devlog #1: What's next?
notes.content:
[h2]Overview[/h2]
I'd like to thank everyone who played the demo at the Steam Next Fest event, and a huge thank you to those who added the game to their wishlist!
In this post, I'm going to talk about the systems and content that will be added to the game between now and launch.
The current demo of the game includes all of the content that has been implemented to date, and I hope to continue to update the demo in the future to see what players think.
Please feel free to play around with the demo and let me know what you think!


[h2]Sail Rework[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/d5e5c3549232d67321302742c16bca1efb39aa37.gif[/img]

First up is reworking the sails.
This work will allow the sails to better represent the direction and strength of the wind, fold and unfold smoothly, change colors, and add emblems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/6280e450fba76d920669f3323dd3a13503ce7a7f.jpg[/img]


[h2]Firing Muskets[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/da4790cacd701ec54ac2e2bb3a5f4af82c3f9a55.gif[/img]
I plan to add a sailor who shoots a musket to give the ship the flexibility to take on different types of enemies, and to keep the battle going even when the ship's cannons are low on ammo.
I'm looking forward to making the game even more scalable with this update.


[h2]Pirate Fortress[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/ea86b1f72cdacf223d692cf04ebaaf418de49370.png[/img]
The pirate fortress will be a challenging fixed objective. Destroying it will require a powerful fleet and skillful command from the player.


[h2]Creature[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/37bf62b135eafe51cbbec7bb564ca4558ef5cf1a.gif[/img]
The creature will be an unexpected threat on your voyage, or you can take your fleet and invade the dragon's nest to slay the dragon and take its treasure.


[h2]Add Biomes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/4883e54287d9472cb3d26e335deec1db5332ff8d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/d9bf14dbaa5e2f60a4e9b1d85d45997306276675.png[/img]
Different biomes will change the look of the city and the goods that can be purchased, and I'm hoping this will make exploration more fun for players.


[h2]And... More Ships![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/48b83006584cb7bda7e40cf8b1559f6e4da7caab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/b99ff63852359e2a19e8b4ad827cb68772eb398f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/90e0f35edadc46b3b5a051a16f4737509a3de293.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43800258/aac5d66c0293d71d6cc20b0787799d72025d4107.png[/img]
These are some of the ships that will be added. My goal is to have at least 10 unique ships available when the game launches. All ships will be configured to allow the player to move around inside. 


[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
In addition to the above, I plan to add many other elements to make the game world dynamic, such as different weather, fish, birds, and different types of quests.
Thanks for reading and stay tuned for more.

Thank you!
